Craft

Three technologies.
One standard.

Every product is made with the tool best suited to it.

Large-format 3D printing

Qidi Max 4

For larger pieces such as vases and lamps — smooth surfaces and seamless lines.

Multicolor 3D printing

Snapmaker U1

Multiple toolheads work together to create vibrant, multicolor objects in a single print — no painting required.

CNC wood milling

3-axis CNC

Natural wood is precisely milled and engraved, then finished by hand, detail by detail.

Why GiaHao One.

Thoughtfully minimal

Nothing unnecessary — just function and the natural beauty of the material.

Considered materials

Plant-based PLA and carefully selected natural wood.

Made in Vietnam

Every piece is designed and finished in Go Quao, Kien Giang.
